name: Leonardo AW139 / MH-139 Grey Wolf
summary: Medium twin used by US offshore, EMS, law-enforcement and VIP operators; the USAF's MH-139A Grey Wolf version guards ICBM fields and replaces the UH-1N.

engines: Two engines side by side on the roof with exhausts angled outward at the back
fuselage: Long fuselage with a pointed nose and large rectangular cabin windows
Retractable tricycle gear, main wheels folding into side sponsons
MH-139: gray USAF paint, FLIR ball and hoist
tail: Horizontal stabilizer near the base of the fin

tellTales: Five main rotor blades on a medium twin
Main wheels retract into stubby side sponsons
Long pointed nose and large rectangular cabin windows

confusedWith.howToTell: The AW139 is bigger with five blades and sponsons; the AW109 is slim with four blades and no sponsons.
The S-76 has four blades and no sponsons; the AW139 has five blades and gear sponsons.
The 412 has four blades on a boxy Huey cabin with skids; the AW139 has five blades and retractable wheels.

usCount.source: FAA registry make/model inquiry (AW139/AB139) + 27 MH-139A delivered (Air & Space Forces / Boeing 2026)
